Congenital radial deficiency and tibial hypoplasia define a skeletal limb malformation syndrome.

Autoinflammatory arthritis; rash is transient. Pericarditis, renal inflammation, pleural disease and uveitis occur in only 5-29%.
ALP deficiency causes profound skeletal hypomineralization; pulmonary hypoplasia with respiratory failure is common (>30%) in the perinatal lethal form.

Acrofacial dysostosis with preaxial and postaxial limb defects defines skeletal involvement; the single reported case does not establish other organ involvement.
